payload.artist_html: Case Vincent Miller, Michael Pittman, Xiaoli Wang, Xiaoting Zheng & Jen A. Bright
payload.description_html: Reconstructions of Longipteryx chaoyangensis morphotypes with large teeth (above) and small teeth (below). Colours of different bones indicate which specimen that bone is based on. All sclerotic rings are based on BMNHC Ph-930B. Quadratojugal morphology is unknown in any taxon so is drawn in a dotted line. See the “Methods” section for more details on reconstruction. Scale bars are based on DNHM-D2889 (above) and IVPP V12552 (below)
